public_rationale: Parts of this statement invite empirical research, but the complete claim lacks a stable scoring rule. Structured neural models existed, and neuroscience research reported relevant similarities with autoregressive models. Neither finding refutes 'many'. Conversely, identifying models without explicit grammars would not establish that they ignore compositional representations or are behaviorist.
limitations: Not adjudicable does not mean the characterization is false.
The evidence addresses components of the argument rather than its undefined prevalence claim.
